request: 白底、简洁线条小猫，要灵动；不使用狸花猫原形象。
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: macOS application icon, square 1024 x 1024. Design a beautifully minimal, lively line-art cat on a pure white rounded-square icon tile. The cat is a simple charcoal-black monoline drawing, caught in a light playful forward hop: slightly tilted head with two crisp triangular ears, two tiny dot eyes, a gently curved body, simple tucked front paws, and one long expressive S-curved tail rising behind it. Use only a few confident smooth flowing strokes, approximately 22px thick at 1024 resolution, with rounded ends and generous negative space. The silhouette must unmistakably read as one cat and feel agile, curious and charming at small icon sizes. Flat clean graphic design, consistent line weight, almost no facial detail, no fur texture, no stripes, no colored areas. Center the whole cat in the white tile, occupying around 66 percent of the tile, with no parts clipped. White rounded-square tile about 90 percent of the canvas, macOS-like softly rounded corners, very subtle neutral edge shadow only. The outside of the white tile must be truly transparent. No words, letters, badges, paw-print symbols, decorative marks, extra objects, border, gradient, 3D effect, mockup, multiple icons or presentation layout. Deliver one finished icon.
refinement_prompt: Refine the attached application icon. Preserve the black line-art cat's exact pose, silhouette, expressive raised tail, tilted head and dot eyes. Preserve its placement and proportions. Change ONLY the white icon tile and transparent surrounding edges: make the tile an absolutely flat solid pure white rounded square, with a perfectly smooth antialiased perimeter. Remove ALL gray borders, bevels, shadows, texture, noise, scattered white pixels, paper fragments, jagged halo and stray marks outside the tile. Outside the rounded white square, every pixel must be clean fully transparent alpha. The tile should have clean geometric macOS-style rounded corners and occupy 90 percent of a square 1024 x 1024 canvas. The cat remains a crisp dark charcoal outline with no extra details, no color, no text. This is a final production icon asset, not a mockup.
export: build.sh resizes the PNG to standard macOS iconset representations and packages AppIcon.icns.
